The problem

Every sales tool was built for the person who doesn't carry the number.

The AE is the data source, not the customer. That's the problem Playbk fixes.

01

Your CRM watches you.

Forty fields to update so leadership can read a pipeline report. The AE is a data entry clerk. The manager is the customer.

02

Call recording reports on you.

Records every word. Scores your talk ratio. Builds dashboards your manager loves. None of it helps you win the deal in front of you.

03

Your deal plan is a slide deck.

Stale the moment it's written. Reviewed once a quarter. Never connected to what happened on yesterday's call.

01 — Know your room

Stakeholder Map

Know exactly who matters — and who's a risk.

Champion, Coach, Economic Buyer, Blocker — all mapped with role, sentiment, and personal win. Coverage gaps surface automatically so you always know where you're exposed before the next call.

02 — The framework fills itself in

MEDDPPICC Qualification

Scored in real time. Blockers flagged. Gaps ranked by deal risk.

All 8 qualification components tracked without data entry. You see 20/28 with one weak blocker and know exactly where to focus — before your manager asks the question.

03 — A shared plan, not a stale slide

Mutual Action Plan

Joint ownership on every action. The #1 Ask surfaces automatically.

A live action timeline with dual ownership — your side and theirs. The most critical ask surfaces from your weakest qualification gap so you always know what to ask for next.

04 — Every call sharpens the plan

Call Analysis & Coaching

Red flags surface instantly. Nothing updates without your review.

Paste any transcript. Playbk extracts qualification signals, surfaces red flags with the exact quote from the call, and proposes updates you accept or dismiss one by one.
